svg.aria-label: Managed publishing — only allowlisted files leave the device
svg.title: Managed publishing — only allowlisted files leave the device

g.text: Managed publishing — only allowlisted files leave the device
Static export to GitHub Pages or a folder stays free and local. The managed path builds in a VPC with no NAT and no vault access, scans again, and promotes by pointer.
1 · The desktop resolves publish.yaml, drops private transclusions and EXIF, and asks for a preview build.
2 · The Publish API checks the user's publish grant for this site.
3 · It records the build and returns a presigned URL for the bundle.
4 · Only the allowlisted, sanitized files are uploaded: the private vault never leaves.
5 · A CodeBuild project starts, with no internet and no access to the vault, sync or models.
6 · It runs a builder image pinned by digest (Astro + the approved component registry).
8 · It re-checks links, the public-only graph and search index, CSP and secrets, then writes a new build prefix.
9 · Macie scans new builds for sensitive data; a finding blocks promotion.
10 · The author views the preview through a signed URL, then approves it.
11 · Promotion is one pointer write in CloudFront KeyValueStore (rollback = the previous build); a receipt is stored.
12 · Readers' requests are mapped by a CloudFront Function to the active build path.
13 · CloudFront reads the bucket through origin access control; the bucket is not public.
14 · Custom domains use a Route 53 alias and an ACM certificate.
